nodes.name: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Runs at :10 and :40 past the hour (production only - publish the workflow). Staggered so Companies run before Contacts, Sites, Quotes and Jobs.

nodes.name: Build Sync Window
nodes.notes: Config + time window: last saved window end minus 2 min (or last 35 min on the first run). Edit values here only.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Records
nodes.notes: Simpro Simpro sites modified since the window start (If-Modified-Since). IDs only, 100 per page.

nodes.name: Build Record List
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per changed record ID. Fails loudly on a non-200 or a truncated page cap.

nodes.name: Has Records?
nodes.notes: True: at least one changed record. False: empty window - straight to Finish Run so the window still advances.

nodes.name: Fetch Simpro Record Details
nodes.notes: Full Simpro record per ID, 5 requests per second. A failed fetch is carried forward (not thrown) so the rest still runs.

nodes.name: Select Test Records
nodes.notes: Collapses to ONE item. Applies the test-record rule BEFORE anything is written to HubSpot.

nodes.name: Any Test Records?
nodes.notes: True: at least one test record to sync. False: nothing to write - Finish Run.

nodes.name: Build Upsert Batches
nodes.notes: One upsert per record on the unique simpro_site_id, chunked to 100 per call.

nodes.name: Upsert in HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch upsert keyed on simpro_site_id. Idempotent, so it may retry.

nodes.name: Check Upsert Results
nodes.notes: Batch calls answer 2xx even when records are rejected: inspects every response and guards the result count. Emits ONE state item.

nodes.name: Split Read-Back Requests
nodes.notes: One item per read-back batch call.

nodes.name: Read Back HubSpot IDs
nodes.notes: Batch read by the unique Simpro ID: gives the HubSpot ID of every record just written.

nodes.name: Build Association Reads
nodes.notes: Maps Simpro -> HubSpot IDs, decides the wanted links (LINKS in this node), builds the read requests. ONE state item.

nodes.name: Split Association Reads
nodes.notes: One item per read call.

nodes.name: Read HubSpot Lookups and Links
nodes.notes: Batch reads: HubSpot IDs of the related records + the links each record has now.

nodes.name: Plan Association Changes
nodes.notes: Diffs HubSpot links vs Simpro. Related records not in HubSpot yet are skipped and listed in the run summary. ONE state item.

nodes.name: Split Association Requests
nodes.notes: One item per archive / associate batch call (none = already in sync).

nodes.name: Any Association Changes?
nodes.notes: True: there are links to add or remove. False: already in sync.

nodes.name: Apply Association Changes
nodes.notes: Batch archive (stale links) and batch associate (missing links), 100 per call. Idempotent, so it may retry.

nodes.name: Check Association Results
nodes.notes: Inspects the batch responses for rejected links.

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Once per poll: throws if any record failed (window not advanced, next run retries it); otherwise saves the new window end.

parameters.content:
## [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot Sites Sync
Replaces the poll path of [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot (Scheduled Updates) for Simpro sites.

**Before publishing (manual steps)**
1. Connect credentials on every credentialed node and confirm no 'not connected' warning remains: `SPL Simpro` (OAuth2) and `SPL Account` (HubSpot app token).
2. Set Settings > Error Workflow on this workflow.
3. Publish the five sync workflows, then UNPUBLISH the old [SPL] Simpro -> HubSpot (Scheduled Updates), otherwise records sync twice.

**Behaviour**: only test records sync (see Build Sync Window). Window advances only after a fully successful run.
**FAN-OUT** at Build Record List: one item per changed record until Select Test Records collapses them into one item again. Everything after that is batched.
